text:
maria: Quick heads-up — cutoff is 18:00 UTC today for the 0.23.0 candidate. I pushed a staging bump but didn't tag. Who will own the final tag and canary plan?

owen: I can take the tag + cutover. Plan: run `./scripts/bump_version.sh 0.23.0`, branch `release/0.23.0`, then deploy canary. Any objections?

sara: Docs PR #342 has the changelog entries and release notes ready for handback — needs one more review (non-doc).

lee: Security check: dependency scan was green this morning, Snyk low/med items triaged. No outstanding SEC blockers.

maria: @owen please set canary to 5% and run the fast smoke suite. If perf tests fail we should consider the quant-fallback contingency we discussed.

owen: will set `--canary=5` in the deploy job and kick smoke: `ci/smoke.sh --suite=fast --env=staging`. Kicking now.

devops-bot: Deploy started by owen at 2024-06-15T17:15:03Z — canary 5% — status: in-progress

sara: QA update: regression and core flows passed, perf test 7 is flaky — rerunning (ETA ~20m). If it flaps again, I recommend we defer heavy perf changes to a follow-up patch.

maria: Agreed. Roll plan if perf flaps: 1) cut release with quant-fallback disabled, 2) open a hotfix/patch for perf tweaks, 3) notify product and support. @kevin ok with that?

kevin: fine to ship with a follow-up patch timeline. We need a short blurb for customers in the release notes about the perf tweak follow-up.

sara: rerun finished — perf stable on second try. QA ✅.

owen: Tag pushed `v0.23.0` and branch created `release/0.23.0`. Deploy finished: canary passed, rolling to 100%.

devops-bot: Canary completed — status: success. Full rollout started at 2024-06-15T18:04:12Z.

maria: Nice. Final asks: support playbook updated (PR #345), docs handback merged, changelog trimmed to single-paragraph summary. If anyone has post-rollout checks, ping here. :thumbsup:

sara: I'll do a quick post-roll smoke in prod and report back.

kevin: I'll prepare the marketing blurb and internal note.

owen: thanks everyone — tagging as complete. :party_parrot:
